A successful non-disabled startup/full recovery sweep clears the latch only after returned claimed rows pass the existing marker-clear/veto stage, including the empty-row case. Explicit configuration-off preserves an existing failed latch and does not create one on a fresh instance.

The exact source delta is confined to _claim_pending_obligations and _schedule_resume_pending_sessions. Healthy pending/proved-unsent recovery, normal delivered terminal state, healthy unanswered resume, non-Telegram scheduling, and ordinary inbound sends retain their existing paths.

Independent actual selected boot/scheduler/Base/SQLite replays reproduce two synthetic transport acceptances before and one after for the injected startup open failure. Transaction-exit failure is also contained. Existing parent positive/negative controls are consistent with the delta.
